Hello @deleted-role ! I'm sure you're all wondering how you'll be able to find advantages this season! I'm excited to announce that you'll have a unique system to look for them - we call it Lilypods. This might be a lot, so questions are encouraged! Currently, you are all tadpoles who have just hatched out of your eggs. You will all start in the same location on the map. This system works in 24-hour increments. Every round, you will have 24 hours to use 10 moves to explore your environment. You are free to talk to players on your tribe about what you find. You can move around Lilypods from your submissions OR your confessional. It's up to you where you prefer to do so! Every time the deadline passes, you will receive more moves and the map will update to show other tadpoles' positions.

Proximity chat

Additionally, at each deadline, you will receive a private chat with the players who currently share a square with you! And yes, because you are currently all sharing a square, everyone will be able to talk in one giant chat from now until the next deadline. Lilypods is the only way to find advantages this season.
1:29 PM

Commands

p swim
  • must be followed by left, right, up, or down, e.g. "p swim up". Swim in a direction.
p inventory
  • view your current moves and any items you may have picked up.

Quests

You will find yellow quests around the map. Quests allow you to claim advantages. Most (but not all) are first-come, first-serve. To claim an advantage, you must complete the quest and end the round on a quest space. We will check for completed quests at deadline. If two players try to complete a quest simultaneously:
  • The player with the most moves remaining receives the advantage.
  • If that is tied, the player with the most flowers receives it.
  • If that is tied, the recipient is randomized. # Artifacts
There are purple artifacts in some locations. You must stand on them to activate them. A note Bugs are rare, but possible. Please ping me if you think you found a bug. Good luck! Your starting location looks like this: ⬛⬛⬛⬛⬛⬛ ⬛⬛ ⬛⬛ ⬛⬛ ⬛⬛ ⬛⬛⬛⬛⬛⬛
